repo.description:
## Summary

The SAML source response processor (`ResponseProcessor.parse()`) does not validate the `Conditions` element on assertions. `NotBefore`, `NotOnOrAfter`, and `AudienceRestriction` are all ignored. This allows replay of expired assertions and acceptance of assertions intended for other service providers.

### Patches

authentik 2025.12.5 and 2026.2.3 fix this issue, for other versions the workaround below can be used.

### Impact

Users which poses a valid SAML Assertion can replay it at any time, even after the signed expiry has lapsed.

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

- Email us at [security@goauthentik.io](mailto:security@goauthentik.io)
repo.summary: SAML source does not validate Conditions, timing, or audience on assertions
